description: One page whole, in the shape write_site takes, so you can change it and send it back. Read every page you mean to change first: write_site replaces a page whole. With `site` and no token, the page as its address shows it: on a wiki, the article there; a sold product without its price.

site.description: Any live site's address, as acme.miow.me, acme.com or a page's url, to read what anyone can see there without a token

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: read_page
title: Read a page
